notes: New: Send guests a form by email from a booking, with a link they fill in on their phone or computer.
New: Guests enter their phone, address, emergency contact, arrival time, everyone staying, and their vehicles and boats.
New: Guests can sign the rental agreement online, and the signed copy is saved on the booking.
New: Completed forms are added to the booking automatically, and you get a notice when one arrives.
New: Guest forms online in Settings to connect your own form service, with an optional minimum age.
New: "Send the guest form" is now an option after saving a new booking.
Improved: The new booking screen is shorter, because guests now fill in their own details.
Improved: A booking's page shows everyone staying, their vehicles and boats, and whether the guest form is done.
